name: RmMessageBox
description: Themed message box / task dialog: Show returns the pressed button.

properties.name: Style
properties.description: Theme of this control: Inherit = the form's / application's Theme.

methods.name: Show
methods.description: Shows the box; buttons OK, OKCancel, YesNo, YesNoCancel, RetryCancel, AbortRetryIgnore or "Save;Don't Save;Cancel"; icon Info, Success, Warning, Error, Question; returns the button's text.

python-tk.notes: also draws the control for VB6 (vb-basic) and every GUI Bridge language; native C / C++ / Fortran exes use radforms/controls/rm_*.c
